name: MOTU
_legal_entity: The footer of motu.com reads « Copyright (c) 2008-2026 MOTU, Inc. All rights reserved. » MOTU is Mark of the Unicorn, Inc., of Cambridge, Massachusetts.
_why_a_pro_interface_maker_is_here: MOTU sells audio interfaces, not DACs, and every one of them contains a D/A converter - which is what this catalogue is about. The segment was absent until 2026-11-25 except for RME and Merging, both of which arrived as consumer-facing products. Pro interfaces behave differently in ways that matter: they publish MEASURED dynamic range and THD for the D/A path, which consumer makers rarely do, and they state ADAT channel counts per sample rate. They also, so far without exception, support no DSD at all.
_merged_from_a_duplicate_under_another_n: motu-mark-of-the-unicorn.json named the same maker differently and was deleted on 2026-11-25. One company: MOTU is the trading name and Mark of the Unicorn the full one. The four records carry « motu », so that file survives, and the short name is kept because it is what the maker puts on its own products and its own site. The surviving name was changed from 'MOTU' to 'MOTU'. Keys carried over: none, it held nothing new. Found by an extension of the duplicate-brand guard: the first version compared names EXACTLY and caught three pairs, then left three more because their names differ. The second version compares a NORMALISED name - parentheses dropped, and the words audio, electronics, technology, labs, systems, digital and a dozen others removed - and an exact repeat is an error while a normalised repeat is a warning, because the first is a certainty and the second a presumption. Measured when added: 3 collisions across 324 files, all 3 real.
